input.quote: Customer agrees that, except as otherwise permitted in this Agreement or in writing by M&I, Customer will use the Services only for its own internal business purposes to service its banking customers and clients and will not sell or otherwise provide, directly or indirectly, any of the Services or any portion thereof to any third party
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Tri City, so the preferred position is met. I checked Article 3 (Appointment — no exclusivity or sole-source undertaking), Article 10 (modification/termination of Services), Article 17 (confidentiality/ownership — mutual confidentiality only), Articles 21 and 22, and Article 23 (source code): there is no covenant restricting the businesses we may operate, the providers we may use, or products we may build or buy, and no territory or competitive-activity restriction. The only use limitations are licence-scope terms on M&I's own deliverables — Section 21.7(B) (use M&I's Services for our own internal business purposes and no resale of those Services to third parties) and Section 23.5 (escrowed source code to be used for our own internal processing, no sublicensing or service-bureau use). Those confine how we may exploit M&I's service and code; they do not stop us from developing internally, engaging alternative providers, or competing with M&I, so they fall outside this rule and are not resale/field-of-use restrictions on our own products or brand. Section 21.11(A) confirms acquisitions of additional financial institutions are contemplated and simply roll into the definition of "Customer", with no restriction on acquiring or operating other businesses. No redline proposed; no walk-away exposure (no post-term restriction of any length, and no undefined "competing business" scope).
